A Weekend in the Countryside: 一家人周末去乡村旅行,钓鱼、逛集市,累但开心。

Last month, my family and I spent a wonderful weekend in the countryside. We left the city early on Saturday morning, because the traffic gets heavy later in the day. After two hours of driving, we arrived at a small village surrounded by green hills.

Our room was in a guesthouse with a beautiful garden. In the afternoon, we walked along the river and took many photos. My father, who loves fishing, spent two hours by the water, but he only caught one small fish!

On Sunday morning, we visited the local market and bought fresh vegetables, bread and some homemade jam. Everything tasted better than the food in the city. We came home tired but happy, and we all agreed that we should do it again soon.
